title: PCSO Lotto Results: 6/42 prize over P85M after no winners of major lotto draws on October 8
summary: There were no winners of the two major lotto draws on October 8, 2026 as the Lotto 6/42 jackpot prize has reached P85 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.

blocks.text: There were no winners of the two major lotto draws on October 8, 2026 as the Lotto 6/42 jackpot prize has reached P85 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.
No bettors picked the winning combination of 19-01-20-39-23-11 for the Lotto 6/42 prize of P85,479,191.72.
The odds of winning the jackpot in a standard 6/42 lottery game are 1 in 5,245,786, the PCSO said.
No one also picked the winning numbers of 41-19-04-01-12-22 to bring home the Superlotto 6/49 jackpot of P40,173,383.54.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot are 1 in 13,983,816.
